description_en: Adds a routing algorithm configuration to a logical table
description_zh: 为逻辑表添加路由算法配置
name: AddLogicTableRouteConfig

parameters.help_en: The ID of the table in the logical database. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141875.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 逻辑库的表ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141875.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: table_id

parameters.help_en:
The unique key of the routing algorithm.
You can define a custom route algorithm unique key without any format constraints.
The unique keys of routing algorithm configurations under the same logical table must be unique
parameters.help_zh:
路由算法唯一键。

您可以自定义路由算法唯一键，无任何约束格式。
同一个逻辑表下的路由算法配置唯一键不能重复
parameters.name: route_key

parameters.help_en: The expression of the routing algorithm. You can refer to the DMS documentation to configure the routing algorithm expression. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107594.html
parameters.help_zh: 路由算法表达式，您可以参考DMS的文档配置路由算法表达式，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107594.html
parameters.name: route_expr

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
